items.title: 华为云开展高校AI师资培训,助力智能体教学实践
items.summary: 8月7日,华为云在南京举办AI能力高校暑期师资培训,来自全国32所高校的50余位教师参加.培训聚焦代码智能体教学,通过技术研习...
items.insightText: 重点看任务拆分、工具编排、验证闭环和可复用工程抽象，判断能否迁移到 Auto-Research / Agent Coding 链路。

items.title: AI-to-AI Code Reviews of GitHub Pull Requests
items.summary: AI coding agents are increasingly integrated into software development workflows, operating on both sides of the pull-request (PR) process: AI authoring agents create or modify PRs, while AI reviewers evaluate them. This creates a closed loop in which one AI coding agent reviews…
items.insightText: 重点看任务拆分、工具编排、验证闭环和可复用工程抽象，判断能否迁移到 Auto-Research / Agent Coding 链路。
